description: Business Loan page sections, in the order they appear: hero, the figures band, the three steps, the loan calculator, what determines approval, how it works, why Think SME (twice — “Built by Bankers” and the longer list), the loan types, the Google Reviews slider, the FAQ and the final CTA. This page has no pricing table and no free-tools tabs — its design draws none. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic; as on the Property Cashout page, the FAQ questions here are fields rather than the site-wide “FAQs” posts. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty and the design’s own copy renders instead: because the theme treats an empty value as “use the design default”, a field that ships with copy cannot be blanked from here, only replaced.
